## 2026-07-21 - PGEN-RGX-0090-0001 (tree RGX-0090) — the downstream cold-clone bootstrap recipe REPAIRED: fail-fast seed + `--bootstrap-mode` + stale-artifact diagnosis; end-to-end proof with byte-identical artifacts

Session #188, second of the three director-directed RGX adoption-blocker reports (0091 ✓ → **0090** → 0089).

**The defect (downstream `PGEN-RGX-0090`).** On a cold clone (empty `generated/`), the documented downstream path `make -C rust regex_parser_bootstrap` could not complete: seed step C (JSON → `generated/ebnf.rs`) was REFUSED by the `RGX-0078.5.i.1.t2` annotation-backend guard (the recipe predates the guard and passed no `--bootstrap-mode`), and the recipe then died at step D with the misleading `No rule to make target '../generated/ebnf.rs'`.

**Root cause (tool-backed, reproduced in a scratch CARGO_TARGET_DIR).** Two layers: (1) the seed lacks `--bootstrap-mode` — with the flag the same step exits 0 and writes ebnf.rs (a pipeline audit confirms `bootstrap_mode` switches are annotation-routing ONLY, no codegen-shape change); (2) the report's "ast_pipeline exits 0 on the refused path" is MIS-ATTRIBUTED — the binary exits **1** (the `Err` propagates to `main() -> Result<()>`); the real swallow is the Makefile's `;`-chained `@if` seed compound, whose exit status is the last command's (the succeeding rebuild), so make continued past the dead seed. The same flag-less seed commands were documented in the regex book's build-recipe chapter and the integration contract's cold-bootstrap section — all three surfaces predate the guard.

**The fix (`rust/Makefile` + docs; no Rust change).** The seed compound is now `set -e` fail-fast (any failing step aborts the recipe nonzero at the real error); seed step C runs with `--bootstrap-mode` (the target's own design-comment spelling); a stale-`generated/ebnf.rs` state (older-pin artifact) is diagnosed with an actionable reseed message instead of ~1,500 rustc errors. Book + contract seed documentation corrected in lockstep (+ a contract maintenance entry; versions unchanged).

**End-to-end proof.** Canonical `generated/` moved aside → cold `make -C rust SHELL=/bin/bash regex_parser_bootstrap` completed **exit 0** (guard peak 4,142MB, 70s) and ALL FOUR produced artifacts are **byte-identical to canonical** (regex_parser.rs `1b5bdcf0…`, ebnf.rs `d4c257cf…`, both annotation parsers) — the bootstrap-annotation seed is at FIXED POINT for ebnf.ebnf, so the downstream recipe emits the canonical artifacts. Injected-failure probe (`RUST_AST_PIPELINE=/nonexistent…` override): the recipe aborts make-Error-1 at step B with zero misleading step-D messages. State restored SHA-verified; dual-feature `ast_pipeline` rebuilt; both mdBook gates green.

The counters that are near-zero are the *semantic* ones. **Proposed mechanism — the P-env (`-0099`) pattern, lib-only:** gate `push_rule_context_static` / `pop_rule_context` on a **process-once cached trace-enabled flag**. Trace level is process-level and cannot change mid-parse, so the gate is sound; under fat-LTO the check collapses to a predictable branch on a cached bool and the `Vec` traffic disappears.

⚠️ **No band is derived and none may be.** This slice counts a **population** and establishes the structure is diagnostic-only; it does not measure the per-push cost. An inlined `Vec` push does no allocation and is therefore **invisible to the allocation-traffic decomposition that produced the `-0171` figures**. ## 2026-07-20 - PGEN-RGX-0078-0173 — `.5.j.4` **BATCH-1 DESIGN RECORD: the batch is designed, four banked facts are corrected, a sixth member is discovered, and the band straddles the land bar** (docs + read-only evidence)

Executes the `-0172` NEXT pointer verbatim: one design record naming each batch member's emission site, mechanism, combined acceptance band, falsification bound and pre-adjudicated unit revert **before** the single regen+A/B chain is spent. Instrument: text matching over the lib/emitter sources and the shipped artifact with **custody asserted in-run** (`generated/regex_parser.rs` sha256 prefix `e4924024`; the census **refuses to report** on mismatch), plus one standalone `rustc` layout probe over field types copied verbatim from `mod.rs:654-681`. No build, no regen, no parser run, no gate perturbed.

### Four banked facts corrected

**(1) `ParseError` measures 80 bytes, and the `-0164` fix is half wrong.** The banked mechanism was "box the cold payload => small **and trivially droppable**". Measured:

| shape | `size_of` | `ParseResult<()>` | `needs_drop` |
|---|---|---|---|
| current, inline `ContextualError` | **80** | **80** | **true** |
| boxed cold payload (the `-0164` proposal) | 32 | 32 | **true** |
| index cold payload (side table) | 32 | 32 | **false** |
| index + interned strs | **12** | **12** | **false** |

Boxing narrows the carrier but **keeps drop glue**, because `Box` is itself an owner — so the `drop_in_place::<Result<(),ParseError>>` call the lever exists to remove **survives the banked fix**. Only the index shape is drop-free. **G1-B's design changes from "box it" to "index it".**

**(2) The memo member is not a hash lever.** Both memos are **already** `rustc_hash::FxHashMap` (6 declarations), so `-0170`'s "memo-insert (hashbrown)" tag names a swap that is already done. What the 56 hot `thin_memo.insert` sites actually pay is **two `SmallVec::from_slice` segment copies each** (56 copies against 56 inserts — exactly one pair per site). The mechanism is **segment-copy elision**, consistent with `-0172`'s memory-traffic-dominant spine finding.

**(3) The residual SipHash is in `FactIndex`, not the memo.** Three std `HashMap` declarations with `FxHashMap` imported-and-unused in the same file. The hasher swap **moves from the memo member to C2**, and it is **lib-only**.

**(4) A banked claim is falsified — `rule_context_path()` is not trace-guarded.** The record banks "every `rule_context_path` consumer sits inside `pgen_trace_high!` — outcome-neutral". It is not: the macro expands to the **plain function call** `trace_log(level, file!(), line!(), module_path!(), format_args!(..))`, whose level guard is an **early return in the body** — which runs **after** Rust has evaluated every argument. So the argument is evaluated **unconditionally at every trace level including `none`**, and `rule_context_path()` **always allocates** (`join(" > ")`, else `"<anonymous>".to_string()`). Census: **10 sites, exactly 1 genuinely guarded; 9 are eager**, on the `emit_fact` path and six predicate-query paths. This is a **pure-diagnostic allocation paid on the production parse path** — the landed P-env / P0 class — and it is **lib-only**, added as **batch member 6**.

### The six members

| # | member | emission site | mechanism | class | risk |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | **G1-B** carrier | lib `mod.rs:655` + 10 emitted construction sites | cold payload -> side table + `u32` index (80->32 B, drop-free) | lib+emitter, **regen** | LOW-MED |
| 2 | **C2** fact-ops | lib `semantic_runtime.rs` (3 decls, 26 alloc sites) | `FactIndex` std->`FxHashMap`; kill per-insert **and per-query** `to_ascii_lowercase()`; kill `FactNameKey` clone | **lib-only** | LOW |
| 3 | **G1-C** per-atom | emitter `cascade.rs:1252`, `scan.rs:828` | elide per-atom `ParseNode` + 72-B arena bump-copy + tape push (**2,853** `arena.alloc`, **268** `deriv_boundary.push`) | **regen** | **HIGH** |
| 4 | **memo-insert** | emitter `cascade.rs:690-706` (56 sites) | segment-copy elision | **regen** | MED |
| 5 | **semantic-runtime** | **215** emitted `push_rule_context_static` vs **284** rule methods | the rule-context push/pop is emitted **unconditionally on every rule entry**, incl. zero-annotation rules | **regen** | MED |
| 6 | **trace-eagerness** | lib, 9 eager sites | sink each call behind `trace_enabled(..)` | **lib-only** | LOW |

### The band, and its honest problem

Only members 3+4+5 carry attributed mass (`-0171`: 30.7 + 26.7 + 24.1 = **81.5 ns = 6.45% = 2.8x noise**). Members 1, 2 and 6 are **unpriced upside contributing zero to the band** — per the `-0172` rule (naming is not pricing), none is derived. At the campaign's standard capture fractions:

| capture | ns | % of geomean | x noise floor | clears the -2.0% land bar? |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30% (LOW) | 24.5 | **-1.94%** | 0.85x | **no** |
| 50% (MID) | 40.8 | **-3.23%** | 1.42x | yes |
| 70% (HIGH) | 57.1 | **-4.52%** | 1.98x | yes |

**Acceptance band = -1.9...-4.5%, MID -3.2%** — and the **low end misses both the 28.8 ns noise floor and the -2.0% land bar**. `-0170`'s amended rule requires a combined estimate that clears the floor **with margin**; as priced this one does not, so **the chain is not yet justified on the batch's own numbers**. Stated rather than rounded up.

**Falsification bound:** worse than **-2.3%** (the `-0166` 8-run 2.28% peak-to-peak floor) means the mass model is wrong, not the capture fraction. Between -2.3% and -2.0% is inside noise and therefore not a measurement — also reverted.

**Pre-adjudicated unit revert (decided now):** land or revert **as one unit**, with **no per-lever perf number ever banked from a batch A/B**; triggers = delta worse than -2.0%, any verdict flip on 2,189 corpus + 39 ladder cells, any battery item red, corpus MAX above the settled 483,583 ns, or artifact growth >5%; mechanics = `git checkout` + all-11 regen + byte-identity assertion against the banked vintages, with the `-0166` trap armed (`make focus_regex` **silently no-ops**; only the direct canonical `-o` spelling restores the vintage).

### Recommendation — split the chain, price the cheap half first

**A deviation from the "one regen+A/B" pointer, flagged rather than drifted into.** Members 2 and 6 are **lib-only** — no regen, no artifact-growth bar, no all-11 byte-compare. So: a **read-only pricing pre-flight first** (`--dump-rule-outcome-counts-json` reports per-parse `store_counters` including predicate evaluations and facts emitted — no build at all), then **BATCH-1a (lib-only: C2 + trace-eagerness)**, which buys the first measured number for the semantic-runtime population without spending a regen, then re-price and decide **BATCH-1b (emitter: G1-B-as-index + G1-C + memo copies + rule-context gating)**.

Why the `-0163` instrument rule does not bite that pre-flight: it forbids pricing a *fused-path frame* with counters (enabling them routes the parse to the protocol graph), but **semantic-store event counts are graph-invariant** — the twin is pinned byte-identical on verdict and typed AST, which entails the same facts emitted and predicates evaluated on both graphs. Stated as an argument, not a measurement; the pre-flight should cross-check one cell on both paths.

### Near-miss banked as a standing trap

The first draft of this census used line-oriented `grep -c` over the rustfmt'ed artifact and read **0** thin-memo inserts (actual **56**) and **1,607** `arena.alloc` (actual **2,853**), because generated code routinely splits one call across lines. Every pattern is now matched whole-file. **Standing rule: a line-oriented count over a generated artifact is wrong until proven otherwise.**

## 2026-07-20 - PGEN-RGX-0078-0172 — `.5.j.4` **SPINE-DISPATCH STEP-0: the "22-25% spine dispatch" population is NOT dispatch — the lever does not exist** (read-only)

Executes the `-0171` NEXT pointer (step 1 of the corrected stack). Instrument: `otool -tV` on `preserved_probes/regex_perf_probe_c1_1d3fa0ee` with **custody asserted in-run** (sha256 prefix `1d3fa0ee`; the script refuses to report on mismatch). Read-only — no build, no regen, no measurement, no gate perturbed.

⛔ **What was under test.** `-0170` named `spine dispatch self` (22-25% self across all three bands) the largest never-priced population in the profile. The **population is real**; the word under test is **"dispatch"**, which entered the record by reading function NAMES at the top of a self-time table and was never checked against the functions themselves.

📊 **Result — two structural tests, both decisive against the label:**

| function | -0162 self | bytes | instrs | mem | ctl | call |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `cascade_match_piece` | 8.0% | 27,380 | 6,845 | **39.9%** | 25.1% | 4.8% |
| `cascade_match_atom{closure}` | 6.7% | 76,860 | **19,215** | **40.4%** | 22.5% | 4.4% |
| `memoized_call` | 5.2% | 15,664 | 3,916 | **34.7%** | 18.7% | 5.7% |
| `cascade_match_entry_concatenation` | 3.0% | 10,776 | 2,694 | **40.1%** | 25.2% | 4.8% |
| `parse_pattern` | — | 15,080 | 3,770 | **39.4%** | 18.9% | 5.0% |

⛔ **The label is refuted.** A dispatch function is tens of instructions dominated by compare + branch. These are **2,694-19,215 instructions each** (one is a **77 KB** function), control flow is a **minority in every one**, and **memory traffic is the largest class throughout**.

⭐ **What the population actually is: the fused cascade regions.** The D2-B cyclic-spine emitter fused the rule graph and fat-LTO inlined the callees into a handful of giant functions, so their "self" time **is the matching work itself** — input reads, speculation save/restore, node writes — not an overhead sitting on top of it. ## 2026-07-20 - PGEN-RGX-0078-0168 — `.5.j.4` **the campaign's banked `21.3 ns/entry` coefficient is CONFOUNDED and ~2x too large; "the bar is reachable via ENTRY COUNT ALONE" is REFUTED — but entry-count fusion survives re-pricing as the largest lever left** (measurement+docs only)

## 2026-07-18 - PGEN-RGX-0078-0126 — `.5.j.2` STEP-2 pre-emission **PARTITION CORRECTION** (lib-only; artifacts byte-untouched `36e1f5fb`): the `-0124` plan was UNSOUND for CONTENT-CARRYING folds — fixed with a 3-way fold class + per-REFERENCE demand + a named-demotion vocabulary audit; corrected regex partition **96/105/33, demoted=0 (86% eligible)**

**The finding (caught by the pre-emission design review, before any emission code):** `return_ast_is_fold_barrier` classified `Array`/`ArrayAccess`/`QuantifiedExtraction` (and array-embedded spreads) as demand-STOPPING barriers, but those transforms RE-EMIT child `ParseNode`s/content inside their output (`generate_array_transform` pushes child nodes into `ParseContent::Sequence`). Regex instance on the hot spine: `concatenation = piece+ -> [$1**]` was "barrier" while DEMANDED through the all-transparent `pattern → alternation → alternative` chain — its verbatim content needs `piece` NODES, yet `piece` was value_licensed (node build elided). The landed plan simultaneously required and elided the same nodes; a naive STEP-2 emission would have broken byte-exactness or dead-locked on the partition.

**The correction** (census single-implementation, so report and emitter cannot drift): (1) pub 3-way **`TransformFoldClass`** — `ValuePure` (object/scalar literals, identifier, property access, `$text`, rule-level `@transform`: children consumed as folded VALUES) / `ContentCarrying` (array, spread, flatten-spread, array/quantified access-extraction: output re-emits child content) / `Transparent` (`$N`/passthrough/missing). (2) **Per-REFERENCE demand**: a Transparent-`$N` branch demands exactly element N−1's subtree (`resolve_positional_target`: `Element`/`WholeBody`/`StaticSentinel` — the codegen-time collapse of the runtime `$N` match incl. the RGX-0075 Quantified-whole-capture rule); passthrough → whole branch; carrying → its `$N` targets; ValuePure → nothing; DEMOTED rules → whole body ALWAYS (verbatim emission consumes node-form children even when the rule itself is only fold-consumed). (3) A **v1 vocabulary audit** with named demotions (`DirectValueBuildPlan.demoted`, additive JSON + report lane): spread bases must be statically-non-`?`-Quantified targets; flatten items statically `TransformedTerminal`-free; `ArrayAccess`/`QuantifiedExtraction` out of v1. Shared pub fns (`resolved_branch_return_ast` via the now-`pub(crate)` `body_has_single_element`, `rule_branch_bodies`, `branch_value_vocabulary_reasons`) are exactly what the STEP-2a emitter will consume.

**The corrected regex partition** (canonical artifact untouched, dual-feature CLI rebuilt): **barrier=96 / value_licensed=105 / node_locked=33 / demoted=0 of 234 fused — 201/234 = 86% eligible** (was 103/106/25 = 89%). The 8-rule delta (banked byte-diff): the unsound cluster honestly node-locked (`concatenation`, `piece`, `piece_quoted_run_quantified`, the quoted-literal chain, `class_safe_special`, `letter_no_upper_e`) — AND 5 mis-branded carrying rules RECOVERED as full value forms (`entry_concatenation` — the entry-chain hot spine —, `class_body_nonempty`(+`_nocaret`), `conditional_branch`, `modifier_group`). The hot spine holds: `atom`/`literal`/`literal_char`/`class_atom`/`escape_unit`/`counted_quantifier`/`quant_base` value_licensed, `quantifier` barrier. `demoted=0` ⇒ regex's transform surface is fully inside the v1 vocabulary. The leaf carries the full corrected STEP-2a emission design (per-branch modes keep `piece`'s six object branches in-place, so most of the recorded 92.1% elidable population survives).

**Verification:** 4 new unit tests (content-carrying propagation / per-reference `$2` targeting / mixed-Or per-branch precision / named demotion propagating even undemanded) + the 3 STEP-1 tests green unchanged — `fusibility_census` 33/33; `cargo check --lib` clean; artifacts byte-identical by construction (analysis-only lib change; regex `36e1f5fb` sha-verified post-run) ⇒ cert/PCRE2/shape/bench baselines untouched. (2) The scan emitter (`rust/src/ast_pipeline/ast_based_generator/scan.rs`): one frameless `scan_<rule>` per plan rule + one `scan_rec_<rule>` recognizer helper per interior rule — no recursion guard, no entry counter, no coverage/trace, no rule transaction, no memo (all plan rules acyclic token-shaped ⇒ O(k) re-scan; the `.5.i.8` §5.d.3 argument). Furthest-position parity is EXACT by shared implementation: every scan/rec head performs the rule-entry max-update, and the Or byte-switch / FIRST-FIRST₂ prune / Q-guard decisions reuse the protocol emitters' OWN helper functions, so attempted-branch rule entries agree position-for-position. (3) Two call-site seams: fused `cascade_*` bodies (bare-path-only) call `scan_<rule>` in place of the full-frame boundary method; protocol bodies dispatch on `bare_parse` with the protocol arm byte-VERBATIM (the D2-A twin precedent at call granularity). The regex plan: **19 rules (13 text / 5 span_transform / 1 shaped_object; 13 sub-roots / 6 residual; `numeric_backreference` carries the predicate tail) + 6 recognizer helpers** — the full `-0108` attack population plus the equally-qualifying `callout_number`/`digits`/directive-name family; 40 candidates dropped with named reasons.

**Measured (the land gate).** Fat-LTO alternated 5×2000 geomean-of-mins, mimalloc; base = the PRESERVED shipped probe `7310ed73` (the ≈6.11 µs floor), cand `63c227b1` (regenerated D3 artifacts): **6181.0 ns → 5224.4 ns = −15.5%**, per-round ratios `0.849/0.856/0.849/0.848/0.845`, per-pattern best-mins `0.744–0.904` (`digit_sequence` −25.6% — the digit-heavy attack cluster, as modeled) — every round and every pattern faster; an independent same-binaries run measured −14.3%. Base reproduces the tracked 6110.6 ns baseline within +1.2%. **The `.5.i.8` cost model is CONFIRMED: the landing sits inside the pre-recorded profile-consistent −9…−15% expectation** (falsification bar −4% cleared ~4×; the CENTRAL −25.1% upper half was optimistic exactly as the recorded reconciliation predicted). - **The decider.** The authoritative typed-AST — the exact bytes EVERY differential gate compares (`parse_harness_equivalence` asserts `interp.ast_json == oracle_value`) and `parse_sample_ast_json` returns — is **`serde_json::to_value(&ParseNode)` via `#[derive(Serialize)]`**, at THREE boundary sites (`parser_registry.rs:1083`, `parse_harness_interpreter.rs:416`, `parse_harness.rs:457`) — NOT `to_json_value` (a separate return-transform-internal path).

- **Drop-correctness (resolved).** Plain `bumpalo` (only vendored arena, `Cargo.lock:98`) does NOT run `Drop` ⇒ leaks the `String`/`Value` leaves every parse ✗. **`typed-arena`** (small, standard, zero-transitive-deps, rustc `TypedArena` shape) is Drop-correct + hands `&'arena` from `&self` ⇒ B folds `.5.d.3` memo-sharing (memo stores `Copy` `&'arena` ref). Arena created at the boundary, passed as `&'arena Arena` to the parser (no self-referential struct), dropped after the serialize walk = mass-free.
- **Cost of B (accepted):** a viral `'arena` second lifetime — mechanical, COMPILER-CHECKED (a slip is a compile error, never a silent byte diff), INTERNAL-ONLY (public API stays owned `serde_json`) — plus one new direct dep (`typed-arena`).

Value of catching this in scoping: it PREVENTED building the wrong (C) implementation, which would have shipped a broken serializer or burned hours before the oracles caught it. Revised migration order recorded in the tree. ⏭️ NEXT: execute candidate B (add `typed-arena` → `mod.rs` `ParseNode<'input,'arena>` → interpreter mirror → codegen `arena.alloc` construction+regen → thread `'arena` through walkers → debug oracles → fat-LTO measure; land iff faster + byte-identical).

Lazy materialization is **structurally required** by `.5.d.4` (a lockstep DFA advance cannot transform per-branch), so the tool returns there where it composes into a real win. **Next lever ⇒ `.5.d.3` MEMO SUBTREE SHARING** — the null proves the RE-PROFILE #2 ~70% clone/malloc is the memo deep-clones, not the transform. ## 2026-07-12 - PGEN-RGX-0078-0013 — RGX-0078.5.c.2 (SPEED PHASE): FIRST-SET PREDICTIVE DISPATCH LANDED — regex geomean −75% (~4× faster, ≈303µs→76µs), byte-identical

The biggest single RGX-0078 speed lever to date, and the payoff of the `.5.c.1` design spike. **Root cause** (`.5` profile): regex parse time is dominated by one rule — `atom`, a ~24-way `longest_match` branch tournament tried at every input character (`parse_atom` = 7565 profiler samples); under longest-match the engine evaluates EVERY alternative and keeps the longest, so at a plain literal char it still sets up, tries, and rolls back ~23 branches that cannot match — each paying a `try_parse` + `extract_delta` + a C3-B rollback-label `format!` (993 sites) + the per-attempt allocation. The profiled 59%-malloc and 6%-string buckets are the same defect seen twice: *"evaluate every branch, then discard most."*

**Fix** (codegen, parser-AGNOSTIC — every whitespace-sensitive grammar inherits it; NOT grammar-name-gated): new shared module `rust/src/ast_pipeline/first_set.rs` (the sound `FirstSetSummary` first-set analysis moved VERBATIM out of `annotation_validator.rs` — the four functions are pure, so the move is behavior-preserving and both the validator's ambiguity lints and codegen now share one algorithm), plus a FIRST-set prune guard in `generate_or_logic`. For a **rule-top-level `Or`** in a **terminal-whitespace-sensitive** grammar, each non-nullable + fully-resolved branch is wrapped in `if parse_start < input.len() && matches!(input.as_bytes()[parse_start], <first-bytes>) { … }` — skipping the entire branch body when the next input byte cannot begin any of the branch's FIRST terminals. Everything uncertain (nullable, `unresolved`, a regex token, `.`/lookahead/anchor, an unresolved ref) is ALWAYS tried, never pruned. Two soundness refinements derived tools-first before any code (recorded R1–R3 in the tree): **(R1)** top-level `Or` ONLY — `furthest_position` is bumped at rule ENTRY, so only there is `parse_start ≤ furthest` already ⇒ pruning is `furthest_position`-neutral by construction (a nested `Or` whose rule-ref branch would enter a child at `parse_start` could otherwise change furthest on reject → deferred to `.5.c.2.a`); **(R2)** gated on `layout_sensitivity().terminals` — the raw next-byte peek is sound only when no terminal layout-skip precedes the match (regex `@whitespace_sensitive: true` ⇒ **820 guards** emitted; every other grammar ⇒ **0 guards**, byte-identical source); **(R3)** an interior-mutable `grammar_tree` snapshot (`RefCell`, mirroring the existing `uses_match_regex: Cell`) avoids threading `grammar_tree` through 8 `generate_*` functions.

**Speed:** DECISIVE drift-controlled before→after ([[feedback_prove_independence_with_decisive_baseline]]) — BOTH release binaries fat-LTO (distinct sha256 `e2c28021…` with-fix vs `674c3ea4…` no-fix), measured **alternately** (`regex_perf_probe` 2000/200, geomean p50 over the 8 patterns, 3 rounds): NO-FIX `302,722 / 302,390 / 304,455 ns` → WITH-FIX `76,553 / 75,960 / 75,855 ns` = **−74.7% / −74.9% / −75.1%** (a ~4× speedup; ≈303µs → ≈76µs), clean separation, stable across rounds.

**Correctness byte-identical** (pruning is output-neutral BY CONSTRUCTION — a pruned branch would fail at char 1, contributing nothing to the longest_match winner, and does not lower `furthest_position` at a top-level `Or`): `parse_harness_equivalence_gate` GREEN (the interpreter, which has NO pruning, is byte-identical to the generated regex parser WITH 820 guards — verdict + typed AST + `furthest_position`, every registered grammar, seeds 0/7/42 — the strongest oracle for a too-tight first-set); `parse_harness_combinator_gate` GREEN (27/27 combinators + the `a|ab` longest-match discrimination); `parse_harness_semantic_gate` GREEN (36/36 store-gated constructs, diverge=0); regex certificate coverage `fully_certified` `UNKNOWN=0`, spf `0/1/1` at seeds 0/7/42 (== baseline); `regex_ast_shape_contract_gate` GREEN (aligned=4, drift=0); `duality_hunt_gate` GREEN (no new signature); **all 9 non-regex parsers regenerate BYTE-IDENTICAL** (json / systemverilog_preprocessor / scratch / rtl_const_expr / vhdl / rtl_frontend / return_annotation / semantic_annotation + systemverilog 69MB) — proving output-neutrality for every non-terminal-sensitive grammar; strict-source clippy exit 0 (changed files zero warnings); 58 `annotation_validator` unit tests pass (verbatim move behavior-preserving). This is the sound **first mile** of the fuller lockstep-simulation road (Thompson-NFA / RE2 / GLL); `.5.c` node done, follow-ons `.5.c.2.a` (nested-`Or` pruning) + `.5.d`/`.5.e` queued. Files: `rust/src/ast_pipeline/first_set.rs` (new), `ast_based_generator.rs`, `annotation_validator.rs`, `mod.rs`; docs: `docs/tasks/RGX-0078.md`, `docs/book/src/inside-parser-performance.md`, `MEMORY.md`. Status rows UNCHANGED (regex already `Done`/signoff-grade; this is a speed lever on top).

## 2026-07-12 - PGEN-RGX-0078-0009 — RGX-0078.5.c.1 (SPEED PHASE, docs-only): director-steered PIVOT to FIRST-SET PREDICTIVE DISPATCH + root-cause correction + design spike DONE

Director steer, this session: *"we let the parser blindly try every branch in the hope one succeeds — naive; works for accuracy, not speed."* Acting on it produced a **tool-backed root-cause correction** and a concrete, feasibility-proven design for the next `.5` lever.

**Root-cause correction (the `.5` re-profile mis-attributed the WHERE).** Starting `.5.b` (defer the `try_parse` Err arm's trace-only `caller_context` Strings), a tools-first audit of ALL `rollback_to_named` codegen emission sites + a grep of the CURRENT regex parser found the `try_parse` Err arm is only **2 sites** in `generated/regex_parser.rs`, while the SAME trace-only-`caller_context` root cause at the **C3-B per-branch tournament cleanup** (`ast_based_generator.rs:3873` `format!("{} (C3-B branch {}/{} cleanup)")`) is **993 sites**. The `.5` re-profile call-graph (`reprofile.txt`) confirms it: `RegexParser::parse_atom` = **7565 samples** (dominant leaf), with `alloc::fmt::format_inner` / `String::write_str` / `rollback_to_named` ALL its nested children — i.e. the profiled ≈6% string bucket is dominated by the tournament cleanup, NOT the 2 try_parse arms. So the `.5.b` fix as scoped is ≈null for regex; it was implemented (byte-identical by construction) then **REVERTED**. The 59% malloc + 6% string are BOTH symptoms of ONE root cause: **evaluate every branch, then discard most.**

**`.5.c` — first-set predictive dispatch (parser/EBNF-agnostic, chosen next lever).** Before a multi-branch tournament evaluates a branch, peek the next input char and SKIP (prune) any branch whose sound FIRST-set over-approximation cannot begin a match — eliminating the pruned branches' entire try / `extract_delta` / `format!` / `rollback` / malloc at the source. **BYTE-IDENTICAL by construction** (a pruned branch would fail at char 1 → contributes nothing to the `longest_match` winner). ⛔ **PRUNE, never PEG-commit**: committing by lookahead is sound ONLY when the survivor set is a singleton; ≥2 survivors still tournament (the longest_match winner depends on FULL match length, not the first char — `a|ab` on `"ab"`), per [[project_earlier_always_matches_unsound_backtracking]].

**Design spike `.5.c.1` DONE (F1–F4, tools-first, no code).** F1: a reusable, sound `FirstSetSummary { terminals, nullable, unresolved }` analysis already exists in `annotation_validator.rs` (`unresolved`=conservative "don't prune"; cycle/depth-guarded transitive refs). F2: codegen's tournament `generate_or_logic(alternatives: &[ASTNode])` iterates the SAME `ASTNode` type + threads the normalized `grammar_tree` ⇒ compute the guard from the exact branch node it guards → aligned BY CONSTRUCTION (reuse the ALGORITHM, not the raw-AST cached result). F3: regex `atom` = ~24 metachar-disjoint rule-ref branches (`.`/`[`/`(`/`\`…) ⇒ ~24→1-2 survivors on a plain literal char (large, sound win). F4: guard skips the whole branch body; `unresolved`/`nullable` branches emit NO guard (soundness); the equivalence/combinator/PCRE2 gates ARE the soundness oracle. Implementation is `.5.c.2` (next).

**Concurrency (director `fork/join_any` refinement) — right instinct, wrong grain for the inner Or-node.** Assessed + set aside with three converging tool-backed reasons: (1) granularity (ns branch-work vs µs thread-sync); (2) it MULTIPLIES the profiled 59% state-cloning malloc (N copies not 1); (3) `join_any` returns the first-to-FINISH = the SHORTEST match = the WRONG longest_match winner (parity break), and the deterministic `join_all` form waits for the slowest (no latency win); plus the Rust `&mut`/`Arc<Mutex>` ownership wall, and the parallel-parsing literature parallelizes INPUT REGIONS of large inputs, never one Or-node's branches. **Promoted to `.7`** at the correct grain: one-whole-parse-per-task batch `fork/join` + parse-cache (RGX/embedding-API side), the natural home for concurrency. Docs-only slice: `docs/tasks/RGX-0078.md` (`.5.b`/`.5.c`/`.5.c.1`/`.5.c.2`/`.7` nodes + F1–F4 + considered-parallelism blocks) + `MEMORY.md`. No code changed; repo returned clean before this commit. Status rows UNCHANGED.

## 2026-07-12 - PGEN-RGX-0078-0006 — RGX-0078.5.a (SPEED PHASE): first SOURCE/ENGINE lever LANDED — FxHash the per-rule annotation-table lookups, −5.4% geomean, correctness floor byte-identical

The first `.5` source/engine speed lever is committed — the build-flag phase (`.4`) is done, so this attacks the profiled cost directly. **Root cause** (`.2` profile, macOS `sample`, release): the SipHash/hashmap bucket = **6.0%** of regex parse self-time; the call-graph named the per-rule-entry lookup functions `has_rule` / `pre_predicates_for_rule` / `needs_raw_post_capture_for_rule` / `needs_raw_final_capture_for_rule`, all of which funnel through `directives_by_rule.get(rule_name)` / `.contains_key(rule_name)` — evaluated on **every rule entry and every backtrack** under the `longest_match` atom-tournament. The two tables were std `HashMap`, i.e. the default `RandomState` **SipHash** (a cryptographic, DoS-resistant, deliberately slow hash) — pointless for the grammar's own fixed rule-name keys. **Fix** (`rust/src/ast_pipeline/semantic_runtime.rs`, shared engine, parser-AGNOSTIC — every grammar's generated parser AND the interpreter share `CompiledSemanticRuntimeAnnotations`): switch `directives_by_rule` + `branch_directives_by_rule` to `rustc_hash::FxHashMap` (the Optim-#6 memo hasher). The public constructors (`from_parts` / `from_rule_directives`) keep taking `std::HashMap` and convert at the boundary (`.into_iter().collect()`, one-time O(rules) at construction), so the generated parser's emitted `from_parts(...)` / `set_fact_kinds(...)` calls are UNCHANGED — **NO codegen/regen**. `fact_kinds` / `predicate_defs` left std (not the profile-named hot path).

**Speed:** DECISIVE drift-controlled before→after ([[feedback_prove_independence_with_decisive_baseline]]) — built BOTH release binaries (fat-LTO, distinct sha256 `ff61ca80…` no-fix vs `674c3ea4…` with-fix) and measured them **alternately back-to-back** (`regex_perf_probe` 2000/200, geomean of noise-floor mins, 3 rounds): NO-FIX `323,050 / 318,777 / 317,913 ns` vs WITH-FIX `304,007 / 298,187 / 306,160 ns` = **≈ −5.4% geomean** (per-round −5.9% / −6.5% / −3.7%; ≈320µs → ≈303µs). Clean separation (worst with-fix 306,160 < best no-fix 317,913), every one of the 8 patterns improved in every round.

**Correctness floor — the ⛔ HARD constraint, every oracle green at its pre-optimization value.** Byte-identity is ARGUED by construction (the two maps are accessed EXCLUSIVELY by point lookup — `get`/`contains_key` — and only ever *counted* via `.keys()` in `len()`, never iterated for any output-affecting purpose, so a hasher swap cannot change output; FxHash's fixed seed is also strictly more deterministic than the std `RandomState`) and PROVEN by the re-run oracles: **PCRE2 compile-oracle** — decisive fix-vs-no-fix diff on the safe 2188-cell subset (80-deep-paren `line_4674` excluded up front) returns `1878/310/262/48` either way, per-case observations `diff` EMPTY → not one new false-accept/false-reject; **regex cert-coverage** (seeds 0/7/42) `total=267 witness=258 UNKNOWN=0 fully_certified=true` spf `0/1/1` — identical to `.3`/`.4.a`; `parse_harness_equivalence_gate` / `parse_harness_semantic_gate` (36/36) / `duality_hunt_gate` (no new signature) / `regex_ast_shape_contract_gate` all GREEN; clippy strict-source exit 0 (the non-strict generated-parsers clippy pass shows only pre-existing generated-code debt, unchanged by this lib-only source change). Behavior-neutral internal perf change → no contract/schema/ledger bump. Lockstep: `RGX-0078.md` (`.5.a` leaf → done, `.5` frontier) + `inside-parser-performance.md` scoreboard (`.5.a` row + plain-terms paragraph + "levers ahead" #1) + `project_rgx_0078_regex_slowness_followup.md` + `LIVE_ACHIEVEMENT_STATUS` (tracker note; status rows UNCHANGED) + `MEMORY` + `DEVELOPMENT_NOTES`. Next `.5` lever: per-speculation arena/reuse (the 59% malloc).

## 2026-07-11 - PGEN-RGX-0078-0004 — RGX-0078.4.b (SPEED PHASE, docs-only): `target-cpu=native` MEASURED and REJECTED — a ~+4% regression, not the assumed free win

## 2026-07-11 - PGEN-REGEX-PCRE2-0047 — REGEX-PCRE2-FIDELITY.4.7.b: relative-zero scan-substring capture reference now REJECTS (behavior-CHANGING accepts-invalid fix) + the numeric-migration WITNESSING WALL

Release `1.1.103`→`1.1.104`, contract `1.1.105`→`1.1.106`, schema `1`, ledger `REGEX-0113` (per the `.4.11` precedent). A RELATIVE scan-substring capture reference of value zero — `(*scs:(+0)…)` / `(*scs:(-0)…)`, including leading-zero `(*scs:(+00))` / `(*scs:(-00))` — now REJECTs (`E_PARSE_FAILURE`; PCRE2 10.47 err 126 "a relative value of zero is not allowed"). The released validator ACCEPTED-invalid these: `validate_scan_substring_capture_refs` resolved `+0`→`prior_count` and `-0`→`prior_count+1` and rejected only a 0-or-out-of-range *resolved* index, with no guard on the relative reference *value* being 0. Absolute `0`/`00` were already rejected (resolved index 0); every nonzero ref (`(*scs:(1))` `(*scs:(-1))` `(*scs:(+1))` `(*scs:(01))`) is unchanged. Fixed with ONE validator guard (`is_relative_reference && reference == 0`); the grammar is byte-unchanged.

**🧱 The numeric-migration WITNESSING WALL (surfaced to the director; `docs/decisions/project_scs_numeric_migration_witnessing_wall.md`).** The originally-planned `.4.7.b` — split `scs_capture_number` by sign so absolute gets `fact_count_at_least phase:final` and backward `-N` gets `phase:post`, shrinking the validator to `+N` — was BUILT and oracle-proven at the grammar layer, then REVERTED. cert-coverage (tools-first) exposed that sound scan-substring generation is **absolute-only**: the `@gen_predicate fact_count_at_least(regex_capture_group, $value)` compiles to a VALUE-DRAW `IndexUpTo` that whole-render-replaces `scs_capture_number` with an integer in `1..=prior_count` (empirically 0 signed scs refs in 60k stimuli). So the sign-split cannot keep BOTH `fully_certified` (with whole-render-replace the signed rules are never generated ⇒ `UNKNOWN=2`, measured) AND `spf=0` (with generation descent the forward `+N` branch renders unsound refs the validator rejects ⇒ spf spike — the [[project_gen_side_no_lacks_fact_branch_prune]] / `.4.8` A′ class). Forward `+N` is the exact blocked forward/suffix-count class of `.4.7.c` (the reach-driver cannot synthesize a trailing group). The migration also carries zero correctness value (the validator already handles absolute/backward correctly), so the whole numeric migration is ABSORBED into `.4.7.c` (to land as a unit when a forward/suffix-count primitive exists) and only the real bug is fixed at the current owner.

**Proven (re-runnable oracles).** `pcre2test` 10.47 (err 126, err 115 for absolute-0); full-pipeline confirmation that the released parser ACCEPTED `()(*scs:(+0)a)` / `()(*scs:(-0)a)()` before the fix (`parseability_probe`); new `rejects_scan_substring_relative_zero_capture_refs` (validator unit) + `regex_scan_substring_relative_zero_refs_reject_pcre2_faithfully` (full-pipeline registry pin, 5 rejects incl. mixed list + leading-zeros, 4 nonzero-accept guards, both profiles reject the zero forms). NO REGRESSION (grammar byte-unchanged): regex cert `total=267 witness=258 UNKNOWN=0 fully_certified=true spf=0` seeds 0/7/42 (fully_certified PRESERVED — the wall avoided); the `.4.7.a` named test + all scs validator/registry tests green; `regex_parser_pgen_rgx_0086_embedding_version_consts_match_ledger` + `regex_parser_integration_contract_metadata_is_stable` green (consts↔ledger↔manifest = `1.1.104`/`1.1.106`); clippy source-strict exit 0. LOCKSTEP: embedding_api consts + JSON manifest + contract identity + "Release 1.1.104 / Contract 1.1.106 Highlights"; ledger `REGEX-0113`; regex book `changelog-index.md` + `compile-contract-validator.md` + HTML regen; top-book `parser-families.md`; decision note + INDEX; tree `.4.7.b`/`.4.7.c` + `TASK_TREE.md`; `LIVE_ACHIEVEMENT_STATUS.md`; `DEVELOPMENT_NOTES.md`; `MEMORY.md`.

## 2026-07-11 - PGEN-REGEX-PCRE2-0046 — REGEX-PCRE2-FIDELITY.4.7.a: NAMED scan-substring capture references are now GRAMMAR-owned (behavior-neutral validator→grammar migration; 2nd consumer of the `phase: final` primitive)

NO release/contract/schema/ledger bump — surface- & conformance-NEUTRAL (the `.3.16`/`.3.17` precedent). A NAMED scan-substring capture reference `(*scs:(<name>))` / `(*scs:('name'))` must reference a capture name defined SOMEWHERE in the pattern (forward references legal); an undefined name REJECTs at parse completion (PCRE2 err 115). This was already rejected by the out-of-band `validate_scan_substring_capture_refs` (load-bearing); the check now lives in `grammars/regex.ebnf` as the **second consumer** of the `FINAL-PHASE-PREDICATE` whole-input deferred-obligation primitive after `.4.11` — a `has_fact(regex_defined_capture_name, $name) phase: final` gate on `scs_capture_name`, checking the `.4.11` parse-side capture-name inventory. The validator's NAMED branch + `CaptureInventory.names` are DELETED (numeric refs stay validator-owned pending `.4.7.b`/`.4.7.c`).

**The reshape + the tools-first reference-resolution finding.** `scs_capture_name` was a bare-string `-> $1`. A parse `@predicate` arg resolves against the rule's PRODUCED STRUCTURE, and — proven by an in-process interpreter probe of three candidate designs (`interpret_parse`, no regen) — ONLY a shaped object-key reference resolves on a bare-string carrier at `phase: final` (positional `$N` and `$text` do NOT: `$text` routes to an object-key "text" lookup that misses a bare string; positional `$N` is unresolved in a directive payload). So `scs_capture_name` is reshaped `-> { name: $1 }` and gated with `$name` (the proven `.4.11` shaped-field idiom); `scs_capture_name_ref` extracts `-> $2.name` so the embedded `captures` AST is byte-identical. Single-branch ⇒ no `view: shaped` needed (the `.3` other-view fallback covers the default `raw` view). The pre-existing `@gen_predicate has_fact(regex_capture_name, $text)` is unchanged (`$text` = matched name, unaffected by the reshape) — generation stays duality-clean via the `.4.11` gen-source/parse-inventory two-fact split.

**🔎 Surfaced in-slice (be-alert):** the `.4.7` regen brought the local `generated/regex_parser.rs` current with the committed `.4.11` grammar and surfaced two STALE assertions in `regex_parseability_adapter_accepts_valid_regex_and_rejects_garbage` — standalone `(?P=name)` / `(?&name)` (UNDEFINED name) were asserted `Some(true)` (pre-`.4.11` accepts-invalid) but `.4.11` correctly rejects them (`pcre2test` 10.47 err 115). Fixed to `Some(false)` — a stale test `.4.11` left behind, not a `.4.7.a` regression.

**Proven (re-runnable oracles).** Named scs oracle 8/8 vs `pcre2test` 10.47 (undefined REJECT via the grammar `phase:final` gate — self-explaining `whole-input predicate 'has_fact' not satisfied … regex_defined_capture_name, zzz`; defined forward+backward across all 3 definition delimiters + mixed numeric+named ACCEPT); AST byte-identical 4/4 named-scs accept cases (`--parse-dump-ast-pretty` before/after regen); regex cert `total=267 witness=258 UNKNOWN=0 fully_certified=true`, spf **0/1/1** seeds 0/7/42 = the `.4.11` baseline; `--lint-grammar` 0 errors (267 rules); `ast_shape_contract` regex **aligned=4 drift=0 regression_lock_failures=0** (3 return-annotation inventory entries re-synced, accepted-AST byte-identical); `parse_harness_equivalence` regex **CLEAN 57/57** (interpreter mirrors the new gate); new grammar-layer test `regex_scan_substring_named_refs_reject_at_the_grammar_layer_pcre2_faithfully` + 36 `regex_compile_validation` unit tests green.
